metric_interpretation: One canonical effective-proposition universe R disjoint union N disjoint union F. One universal generated class may support multiple source atoms. The class count G does not equal TP+FP. TN is restricted to 37 fixed controls.
limitations_en: This uses retrieval-assisted bounded semantic support decisions over exact PDF quotations, not an independent full human predicate audit of 2,624 generated classes.
Provisional GENERATED_ONLY unsupported classifications can include eligibility/atomization defects from the corrected Phase-3 raw class inventory; they must be challenged in Phase 5.
The 403 Phase-3 source-negative decisions include conservative unresolved cases; arithmetic Recall is not certified true omission rate.
Unapproved proposals are not promoted to definitive generated commitments. The fixed 37 negative-control inventory is not an exhaustive true-negative population.
Phase 4 does not complete Phase 5 correction or Phase 6 final independent certification.
